FAMILY.text: Everythink was amazing the Staff the Food the Welcome Thanks ❤️
The service is second to none. The staff is very proffesional and attentive. The facility is a small, well maintained and run resort by the sea. We will definitely come back.

COUPLE.text: The location is excellent, and the staff are very friendly. The entertainment was enjoyable, and the pool was great. The food wasn't bad; you're sure to find something you like. It's definitely a value-for-money hotel. I recommend it.
This is definitely not a 4 star hotel. It is only 2 stars hotel

SOLO.text: Everything was really nice, the whole staff were very polite and professional.
Nice hotel, not too big. Great food. Friendly staff. Bodrum marina is just under a 1-km walk.

FRIENDS.text: The hotel and grounds and the room were beyond amazing. Not to mention the views.... Only problem is some staff don’t speak English n we had problems with it. But I notice this is normal all over turkey even in 5 star hotels
We had a very very nice experience with the hotel, the staff and managers were incredibly nice! 10/100 definitely will come back
